title: A ring map is formally unramified iff its module of differentials vanishes
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $S$ an $R$-algebra via $\varphi$, and let $\Omega_{S/R}$ be the module of Kähler differentials of $S$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. The following are equivalent: (1) $\varphi$ is formally unramified, i.e. for every $R$-algebra $A$, every ideal $I\subseteq A$ with $I^2=0$ (quotient map $q:A\to A/I$) and every $R$-algebra map $a:S\to A/I$ there is at most one $R$-algebra map $a':S\to A$ with $q\circ a'=a$; (2) $\Omega_{S/R}=0$.
